title: Sonia Sotomayor and the Power of Preparation
short_teaser: Sonia Sotomayor has described how disciplined preparation helped her navigate unfamiliar institutions and demanding work.
story: Sonia Sotomayor has described how disciplined preparation helped her navigate unfamiliar institutions and demanding work. Preparation can create steadiness when belonging does not yet feel secure. A life story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
